title: Relaxed RMW without Fence (Unordered Counters)
pattern: Using a relaxed read-modify-write operation (like `fetch_sub` with `Relaxed` ordering) to decrement a reference counter that gates resource reclamation.
why_bad: Relaxed operations do not order surrounding memory accesses. The compiler or CPU can reorder the actual memory access of the resource cleanup *before* the decrement is finalized, allowing concurrent readers to access freed memory.
detection: An atomic decrement gating resource deletion or cleanup using relaxed memory ordering without a surrounding acquire/release boundary or fence.
counterexample: Using `Release` ordering on the decrement and an `Acquire` barrier on the cleanup path.
